caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sideboard with a reddish-brown, highly polished surface and a distinctive wood grain pattern. The sideboard has four doors on the lower section, each rectangular and bordered with lighter trim, and four short, carved columns between the doors and at the ends. The top section features a narrow backboard with three paneled sections, vertically aligned with the doors below, and a wide, flat surface. There are three round brass or gold-colored handles on the horizontal drawer just below the tabletop, spaced evenly across the width. The sideboard stands on six feet, each foot shaped to resemble an animal paw. The background is a plain, light beige color. The lower right corner of the drawing contains a handwritten signature reading "Geoffrey Holt."
title: Sideboard, Mahogany
